TikTok shows a bot-check to downloaders. Paste the ms_token cookie from your browser to unlock TikTok downloads.
How to find it: open tiktok.com in Chrome → F12 → Application → Cookies → tiktok.com → copy the ms_token value (and tt_chain_token if present).
Open tiktok.com in Chrome on your computer and log in to your TikTok account.
Press F12 (Windows) or Cmd+Option+I (Mac) to open DevTools.
Tap the "Application" tab at the top of DevTools.
In the left panel, open: Storage → Cookies → https://www.tiktok.com
Double-click its Value column and copy the whole value (it is very long).
Paste it into the ms_token field above and tap Save.
Tip: if TikTok still shows a login request, also copy tt_chain_token the same way.

YouTube sometimes blocks downloads with a bot-check. Paste the Cookie header from a browser where you are signed in to YouTube.
How to get it: open youtube.com in Chrome → F12 → Network → reload the page → click any request → Request Headers → copy the whole Cookie value.

Some Facebook Reels and Profiles require login cookies. Paste your Facebook Cookie header or tokens from your browser here.
How to get it: open facebook.com in Chrome → F12 → Application → Cookies → https://www.facebook.com → or Network tab Cookie header.
